description: Routing case — a scheduling request routes to Calendar Agent, the only Composio specialist with zero eval signal of any kind (#195). Real Gemini drives the routing decision; Calendar Agent registers as a handoff target even without Composio tools. must_not_route_to forbids Buildium/Web/Browser/Document/Gmail so 'maintenance inspection at 2 Elm Street' doesn't drift to the maintenance-flavored Buildium Agent or to Gmail.
